refactor: replace old stream system with new message event system

  Remove the legacy stream logic (StreamNo, StreamMeta, StreamV2, StreamCache,
  /stream/open, /stream/close, /event APIs) which has been fully replaced by
  the new message event system (MessageEvent, MessageLaneState, eventAppend/
  eventSync APIs).

  Deleted files:
  - internal/api/stream.go, event.go
  - internal/channel/handler/event_onstream.go
  - internal/plugin/rpc_stream.go
  - pkg/wkdb/stream.go, streamv2.go
  - pkg/cluster/store/stream.go
  - pkg/wkcache/stream.go, stream_test.go, example_test.go

  Added files:
  - pkg/wkdb/message_event.go (+ tests)
  - pkg/wkcache/message_event_cache.go (+ tests)
  - pkg/cluster/store/message_event.go
  - internal/server/message_event_api_test.go
  - docs/Message_Event_Stream_Design.md, Event_Merge_Rules.md,
    Event_DB_Methods_Pseudocode.md

  Key changes:
  - Remove StreamNo/StreamFlag fields from eventbus.Event
  - Remove StreamNo/StreamId/Streams from MessageResp
  - Remove StreamDB interface from wkdb.DB
  - Remove stream-related CMD encode/decode functions (preserve iota ordering)
  - Remove StreamCache, stream RPC routes, stream ingress handlers
  - Add MessageEventDB interface with lane-based projection state storage
  - Add MessageEventCache for in-memory delta accumulation
  - Add eventAppend/eventSync API endpoints for the new event system

refactor: rename lane to event key and add real-time event push

- Rename LaneID/MessageLaneState to EventKey/MessageEventState across
  API, DB, cache, cluster, and store layers
- Change API endpoint from /message/eventappend to /message/event
- Add sendEvent() to push events to online channel subscribers
- Auto-fill from_uid and message_id from cache in eventAppend
- Register stream message metadata in send API for cache pre-population
- Add implicit session creation on first delta without prior open
- Add event type/status/visibility constants (EventTypeStreamDelta, etc.)
- Add Agent channel type support in event routing
- Add cluster /message/eventsync forwarding endpoint
- Add is_stream field to cluster message response model
- Update frontend builds and documentation

fix: add missing advance() and sendSyncReq() calls in stepLearner

stepLearner was missing advance() after SyncResp with logs, and missing
sendSyncReq()/advance() after StoreResp and TruncateResp, unlike
stepFollower. This caused learners to rely solely on tick-based sync
instead of forming a continuous sync pipeline, significantly slowing
down log catch-up during node migration.

routing events between Node objects via Step()/Ready(). Covers log

follower catch-up, leader change, heartbeat commit updates, and learner
sync scenarios.

returning, which inflated elapsed from ~Duration to Duration+FlushTime,
deflating reported throughput. Now Flush happens after recording elapsed.

Also add bench step to test-wkcli integration test.

perf: optimize send path throughput and reduce blocking

Based on send stress test profiling (QPS 170 vs baseline 4210), identified
and fixed four critical bottlenecks:

1. asyncCommittedDispatcher: Increased shard channel capacity from 512 to 1000,
   min shards from 4 to 8, max shards from 32 to 64 to reduce message dispatch
   backpressure (940s blocking time)

2. Session write queue: Increased from 64 to 500 to reduce session dequeue
   blocking (900s blocking time)

3. Replica ExecutionPool: Doubled append workers, increased checkpoint workers
   from Workers/2 to Workers, doubled mailbox size (1024→2048), turn budget
   (8→16), and effect queue (1024→2048) to reduce replica append blocking
   (1188s blocking time)

Expected improvement: +200-300% QPS, -60-70% P95 latency

test(channelwrite): fix flaky SubmitLocal benchmarks

BenchmarkSubmitLocalManyChannelsParallel failed under RunParallel
saturation because it treated ErrBackpressured as a correctness failure.
Backpressure (and post-refactor ErrChannelBusy) is a load-shedding
signal; retry transient admission rejection instead of failing.

perf(channelwrite): allocation-free channel-key hashing

Replace fnv.New64a()+[]byte(value) with an inline FNV-1a loop: faster,
guaranteed alloc-free across platforms, drops the hash/fnv dependency.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

perf(channelwrite): record phase 1 results, drop Future pooling

Future buffer pooling measured as a regression (+1 alloc/op) with no safe
release point under the current lifecycle; deferred to the Phase 2
restructure. Allocation-free hash retained.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(channelwrite): add channelWriter struct and shared worker pool

channelWriter is the per-channel single-writer state machine (Task 2.1);
workerPool wraps a blocking ants pool to run append/post-commit effects
off the advance call stack (Task 2.3).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(channelwrite): writer enqueue and CAS activation

enqueue/tryActivate/deactivate enforce the single-writer invariant via an
atomic scheduled flag; deactivate re-checks for late work to close the
lost-wakeup window. Adds channelState.hasPendingWork.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(channelwrite): writer advance loop with append+commit transitions

advance() is the single state-machine entry: drains the inbox (prepare
inline), submits append/commit to the shared pool, and reschedules on
completion. Ports the reactor's in-order append completion and post-commit
scheduling onto the per-writer lock. Relocates appendTraceMessageSeq to
append.go and extracts postCommitFailureFromEvent for reuse.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(channelwrite): shard with striped writer creation

shard owns a hash-selected subset of writers; getOrCreate uses
double-checked locking so concurrent submits to a new channel converge to
one writer. Lock guards only lookup/creation, never advance.
